scenes.text: Imagine standing in a secret, fifty mile strip of wild forest land deep inside Yellowstone National Park where you could theoretically commit the perfect crime and walk away completely free.

Known officially as the Zone of Death, this bizarre legal loophole actually exists because the federal government has exclusive jurisdiction over the entire park, which spans across multiple state borders.
However, the Sixth Amendment of the US Constitution strictly guarantees your right to a jury trial comprised of local residents from the exact state and district where the crime occurred.

But since absolutely nobody lives in this specific Idaho sliver of the park, no jury can ever be legally formed, so do you think Congress should fix this terrifying loophole? Tell me below and follow for more.
